nextBoundary: OFR6 should perform promotion/deletion decisions over reconstructed foundations and the narrower Atlas pattern. OFR7 should test fresh-Agent practical transfer/deletion decisions. Any future Atlas productization must first prove a lower-cost single-loop/native hydration surface under held-out use; OFR5 diagnostics alone are not promotion evidence.
rejectedDesigns: Do not promote the frozen ATLAS_PROGRESSIVE two-call treatment; it fails physical reliability and cost gates.
Do not make per-role hydration the default abstraction; models over-request roles and the granularity adds control complexity without earned savings.
Do not use INDEX_ONLY as causal knowledge; it is a locator only.
Do not use OFR2 cross-owner convergence families as owner-local causal histories/current truth.
Do not let free-form Agent prose own truthRole/currentness/evidence sufficiency/research reopening/mechanism admission/action authority.
Do not create TheoryDB, TheoryService, global registry, auto-reopen rule engine, or owner-truth copy from OFR5.

retainedDesign.escapeHatch: Exact owner/revision/path or commit references; live/current truth requires owner-native revalidation outside Atlas.
retainedDesign.hydrationMechanism: If operationalized later, prefer an existing owner/domain-owned read-only Tool observation in the same Agent loop over a second independent Agent call. The Tool must mechanically carry truthRole/currentness/currentnessAuthority and all false authority flags.
retainedDesign.hydrationUnit: Prefer one complete causal case as the current conservative hydration unit; per-role selection is not earned by OFR5 because selection precision was poor and it did not reduce effective cost reliably.

validatedFindings: A compact owner/case index is sufficient for exact case localization in this corpus: valid Atlas navigation selected the correct case in every observed development/holdout navigation; INDEX_ONLY also localized holdout cases while failing causal detail recovery.
Index-only navigation is not causal theory: holdout requested-role fidelity was 0.50, exact refs 0.0909, and unsupported inference 0.3636 despite 1.0 case localization.

Cross-owner convergence laws are not substitutes for owner-local causal history: CENTRALIZED_LAWS holdout case localization was 0, requested-role fidelity 0.3382, refs 0, unsupported inference 0.8571 and overgeneralization 0.2857.

The first two-stage ATLAS_PROGRESSIVE choreography is not promotable: holdout physical acceptance was 0.50 and effective prompt cost per accepted answer was 0.9509 of FULL_EAGER despite perfect causal-role fidelity among survivors.

Model-selected role granularity did not achieve parsimonious hydration: holdout navigation role recall was 1.0 but precision 0.7237; existing Harness single-loop Tool diagnostic improved reliability but role-selection precision fell to 0.5428 as the model usually requested the full nine-role case.

Exact targeted hydration content is semantically sufficient and substantially smaller: the post-holdout oracle diagnostic recovered requested roles at 1.0 with 0.8333 physical acceptance and ~2043.6 prompt tokens per accepted answer, about one quarter of FULL_EAGER; this is mechanism evidence only, not promotion evidence.

Mechanical ToolObservation truth/currentness/authority metadata matters: the post-holdout single-loop DomainToolLoopRunner diagnostic achieved 12/12 realization, 1.0 requested-role fidelity, 1.0 epistemic-boundary fidelity, and zero unsupported/overgeneralized judgments, whereas all prose-only treatments frequently overclaimed frozen reconstruction as current owner truth or evidence/admission authority.
More theory context does not ensure truth-role discipline: FULL_EAGER recovered causal roles perfectly but holdout epistemic-boundary mean was only 0.6364 with unsupported-inference rate 0.2727.

Current cost bottleneck is no longer missing causal content but repeated context/over-hydration in iterative model loops. The reliable single-loop Tool diagnostic still consumed ~6881 prompt tokens per accepted answer (~85% of FULL_EAGER) because the compact index is seen before hydration and the next Provider turn carries prior context plus often-full-case hydration.
